items.title: Trump’s 250-foot arch gets final approval to begin construction two days after president’s election drubbing
items.brief: A final vote approving President Donald Trump’s proposed triumphal arch passed late Thursday after a marathon public hearing of citizens voicing fierce opposition to the president’s pet project.

items.title: Philadelphia foster mother charged with murder in death of 10-year-old girl whose body was found in a trunk
items.brief: The foster mother of a 10-year-old girl whose disappearance sparked a massive search before her body was found across state lines nearly two weeks later has been charged with murder, Philadelphia officials said Thursday.

items.title: Florida carries out its 19th execution of year as 3 states administer the death penalty in a day
items.brief: Florida carried out a record-tying 19th execution of the year in an unusual instance of three states administering the death penalty on the same day.

items.title: Asian markets follow US rout as AI investment jitters spread
items.brief: Stock markets in Asia plunged Friday, following a tech-led sell-off in the US on anticipation that newly elected Democratic officials could stymie an AI investment boom that’s driven global stocks to record highs.

items.title: ‘Catastrophic’ flooding sets off 100+ rescues, inundates homes and businesses in North Georgia and southern Tennessee
items.brief: Historic flooding inundated homes and businesses in North Georgia and southern Tennessee, leading to dozens of water rescues and evacuations.
